Before your child walks out the door… not a lecture. 🚪 Just 4 things, every morning:

1️⃣ "I love you." So she never has to wonder if your love depends on her day. ❤️
2️⃣ "You can do hard things." And if it doesn't work, try again. 💪
3️⃣ "You're safe with me." So she can tell you anything, even the secrets. 🛡️
4️⃣ "You can always come home." No matter what she has to face. 🏡

At six, she skips out the door. At thirteen, she rolls her eyes: "I know, Mom." 🙄

Then one night, after a big mistake, she's standing outside that door, afraid to knock. 💔

Jesus told a story about a son like that. "But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and felt compassion, and ran and embraced him and kissed him." Luke 15:20 (ESV) 🙏 Not because he earned it, but because he was his son. Jesus gave His life to bring us home.

And that night, the words in her head were yours: loved, safe, capable, always welcome home. ❤️

For a worried child, every door comes with a little fear. Make sure it comes with your words too.

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
